 LIHEAP Applications Are Now Open
 by 
 Nathan Konz 
 November 3, 2026 
 Audubon County , Calhoun County , Carroll County , Crawford County , Greene County , Guthrie County , Local News , Sac County 
 Applications for winter heating assistance are now open to all eligible Iowa households. The federally funded Low-Income Home Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP) helps qualifying households cover a portion of their heating expenses. Iowa applicants must have household income at or below 200 percent of the 2026 federal poverty guidelines. Annual gross income limits include $31,920 for one person and $66,000 for a family of four. Applications opened Oct. 1 for households with someone age 60 or older or someone who is disabled. Other households became eligible to apply Nov. 1. The application period ends April 30, 2027. Residents can apply through their local community action outreach office. Iowans who receive a disconnection notice during the program’s operational period should contact their utility directly to discuss payment plans or assistance. Many utilities offer a form of budget billing, which evens out a home’s electricity or natural gas costs over the year.  More information on how to apply for LIHEAP is available on our website.
